answer: Mechanism: one earning identity per network prefix. Each agent binds to one measured /24 origin; duplicates on a prefix cannot both earn. Accepted prefixes form a public lantern list; the ledger sits in glacier-tier cold storage, append-only and costly to rewrite. Operation: verifiers probe applicants with rotating triangle-routing checks, so one box cannot fake many prefixes; newcomers wait at the wharf until their prefix clears. Attacker cost: each clone needs distinct rented address space and hardware, paid per identity, no bulk discount; one catch freezes all siblings.
